# Spiritual Translation

** ¶3:** Know that the fac ulties of the external mind ab ide within a complete fullness of spiritual states: namely , the five fundamental capac ities of the natural man — those tru ths that proceed from the Lord 's original Divine Wisdom in human form — together with the Divine infl ux itself and the human reception of that influx. These two consec rate and vivify the five faculties, dwelling within them as their life . Thus they constitute a holy sev enfold order : five capac ities of reception united with the reciprocal bond between what the Divine communic ates and what the will receives .

**¶4:** Likewise , the five tru ths proce eding from the Divine Spirit sust ain the entire burden of spiritual order against the downward pull of evil ; and with them stand the Divine Truth proce eding and the Divine Wisdom in original form, from which these truths desc end as from their origins . These together are the complete full ness of acknowledg ment that the Lord has ordained — worship constit uted of a perfect form of interior confession — through which all spiritual order is established and maintained.

**¶5:** For these things p ertain to interior states of good not yet made conscious to the understanding . This deeper ground of the mind is established though unre vealed. These fac ulties bore up against the assault of falsity and evil, which nothing in the natural man alone could withstand. The hidden full ness of Divine Good — the Divine Truth sent forth from the Divine Good itself — came and established itself at the very center of all these states. He is called the Lord as Divine Good governing every spiritual state and every derivative power that is holy and conjoined with Him . He has become sovereign and ruler of all things in the image of the Supreme Divine Good, the Lord of all divine purposes. All spiritual order is held together by Divine Providence from first things even unto the final consummation.
